_about: Routing knowledge for ask.ps1, route.ps1, fanout.ps1 and council.ps1. Edit this file to change who gets what; no code change needed. Models differ per account: run 'gemini-keys models' to see what your keys can use, and 'agy models' / the Codex model picker for the others.

gemini.what: Gemini CLI on free API keys (several keys). Quota is requests per day per MODEL per key (about 20), so one job = one request: send material inline, never let it roam a folder.
weak_at: pro-level reasoning (Pro models have no free quota)
Google Search (the free keys hit 429 on it)

gemini-app.what: Gemini web app on your Google AI plan, driven by a hidden Chrome. Real Google Search, very large context, file upload, three models (fast / everyday / most capable) with thinking levels.
good_at: current events, prices, versions, docs lookup
huge documents and many files at once
weak_at: more than 25 jobs a day (a safety cap, see limits)

perplexity.what: Perplexity: live web search with cited sources. Uses the Agent API if you saved a key (pay as you go, a few cents per question), otherwise your Perplexity plan through a hidden-Chrome robot (Search mode only). Both can read your Google Drive files through the Google Drive plugin.
good_at: current events, prices, versions, docs lookup
weak_at: API route costs money per request (capped per day)
cannot see your disk (use -DriveFile for files in Google Drive)

codex.what: Codex (ChatGPT login). The only helper allowed to change files.
good_at: tasks that need a sandboxed shell

agy.what: Antigravity CLI on your Google login. Read-only plan mode. The quota is small and resets weekly, so it is the last resort.

claude.what: The boss (Claude Code). Plans, design, decisions, final review, git, anything the user must approve.
weak_at: its own usage limit: do not spend it on bulk reading

web-research.why: needs live web: the app has Google Search grounding; free Gemini CLI keys hit 429 on Google Search, so no gemini here

big-read.why: huge input: the app takes the largest files; split into chunks for the CLI keys

second-opinion.why: wants the strongest reasoning that is free

gemini._about: Candidate models per effort, tried in order; a model that is gone (404) or out of quota is skipped automatically. Check yours with: gemini-keys models

gemini-app._about: lite / flash / pro = the 1st / 2nd / 3rd entry of the app's model menu; think = the thinking level.

perplexity-app._about: Model for the Perplexity web robot, by name as in its Model menu (Best = Perplexity decides). The choice sticks in the profile, so every job sets it. Models your plan locks are skipped.

perplexity._about: The Agent API effort level: low (everyday questions), medium (multi-hop research), high (hardest). Perplexity chooses the model.

codex._about: An empty model means Codex's own default. effort is Codex's reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh).
